Build prompt

Build “Company Offsite Activity & Roommate Matcher” on NeoApps for an offsite organizer. Collect arrivals, optional dietary details, room preferences and activity choices. Give invited respondents their own response and the organizer an aggregate view. Include a demo with fictional records.

Acceptance test

The organizer sees dietary notes. An attendee can edit their own response and cannot open another attendee’s notes.
